messages:
cara: Quick heads-up: scheduling a compact base-image rebuild Tue 09:00 PT. Need RBAC for ephemeral signer, audit sink, and a short canary.
jun: Ack. Which KMS key? ops-oncall wants the principal list for pages.
oliver: Use projects/prod-kms/cryptoKeys/base-image-key. Current ci-signer exists; prefer ephemeral SA for least privilege.
remy: Proposal: kms-rebuild-signer-<runid> SA, TTL 48h, roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier scoped to the key.
cara: Also switch to KMS keyVersion signing (no local private keys) and block signing until vuln-scan green.
jun: I'll open a tiny terraform PR to create SA + binding. Will include cloudasset export.
oliver: I'll add a condition to restrict the binding to the specific key resource and sign action.
remy: Ensure audit: forward key use logs to sec-audit GCS with 1y immutable retention for provenance.
ops-oncall: Must pass image-compat-check (glibc matrix), seccomp profile, and runtime-health before canary. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback on health regressions.
security-bot: POLICY: IAM change needs sec-owners approval. Attach /policies/kms-signing/approval-checklist.md
cara: Action items: Jun PR IAM, Oliver verify conditions, Remy wire provenance upload, Ops run compat & canary, Security approve. Will convene approvals tomorrow 08:30 PT. :thumbsup:
